name: Ansur
backstory: Ansur is an undead dragon found in Baldur's Gate 3. Formerly a bronze dragon nicknamed "The Waiting Storm" and the "Heart of the Gate", Ansur was generally thought to be mere legend. Depending on the party's actions, either Ulder Ravengard, Counsellor Florrick, or Cordula Eltan reveals that Ansur is very real, offering the party a book which starts their journey to seek Ansur and its help against the Absolute.
